div.head: Af 5.1
div.ab: Gif hiwan heora cirican mare ðearfe hæbben, healde hine mon on oþrum ærne, ond þæt næbbe ðon ma dura ðonne seo circe.
Gif hiwan hiora cirican maran þearfe hæbben, healde hine mon on oðrum ærne, ⁊ ðæt næbbe ðon ma dura þonne sio cirice.
Gyf hiwan héora ciricean mare ðearfe hæbben, healde hine mon on oðrum huse, ⁊ þæt næbbe ðon ma dura ðonne seo cyrice.
Si editui magis opus habeant ecclesiam suam, custodiant eum in alia domo, et hec non habeat plura hostia quam ecclesia.
Gif hiwan hiora cirican maran þearfe hæbben, healde hine mon on oðrum ærne, ⁊ ðæt næbbe ðon ma dura þonne sio cirice.
If a household has greater need of their church, let him be kept in another building, and let that have no more doors than the church.
If the community have so great need of their church [that it cannot be used as an asylum], he [the fugitive] shall be kept in another building, and this shall not have more doors than the church.
Wenn die Stiftsgeistlichen ihrer Kirche mehr bedürfen, so bewahre man ihn in einem anderen Gebäude, und dies habe im Vergleich nicht mehr Thüren als die Kirche.
If the clergy of the community have greater need of their church, let him be kept in another building, and let this have no more doors by comparison than the church.
